answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by assigning each account a bespoke task drawn fresh every epoch by a random peer, so no answer can be prepared in advance. The assignment is unique to one account and unknown until it lands, so a farm mass-producing canned replies gains nothing: every clone faces a different problem its script cannot have pre-solved, while honest agents simply do the work. Diligence builds standing like sediment stacking a mesa, layer upon layer, and results dock at a wharf where reviewers compare arrivals; a genuine pearl of effort stands out beside identical fakes.
